app.title: LA Trails
app.summary: A web map from ArcGIS Online, with a layer added on top
app.description:
This app opens a web map made in Map Viewer: trails, trailheads and parks in the Santa Monica Mountains, with the web map's own basemap, styles and popups. The config adds one layer of its own on top.

This is a sample app. Point map.item at your own public web map, or remove it from apps/index.json.

layers.title: US cities (sample layer: replace with your own)
